description: Severe flooding has blocked the main road near the community center. Five families are stranded and need clean drinking water urgently.
A fire broke out in the slum area, destroying three houses. They need temporary shelter and medical kits for minor burns.
Elderly woman living alone has run out of food and essential medicines for hypertension. She hasn't eaten in 2 days.
The local school building roof was damaged during the storm. Children cannot attend classes until it is repaired.
We need emergency medical assistance for a pregnant woman who is in early labor and cannot reach the hospital due to blocked roads.
Several stray dogs in the area are behaving aggressively and have bitten two children. Animal control is required.
